args.description: taekwondo jumping scissor kick: springs straight up kicking both legs high above her head one after the other, then lands. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
